verdict.rationale: Unleash documents official SDKs in both backend and frontend form: 15 official client and server SDKs, over 30 SDKs in total, separate backend and frontend tokens, and frontend SDK evaluation via Edge. A community commenter also names official Java, Node.js, Go, Ruby and Python clients. However, nothing in the pack shows mobile SDKs or guarantees consistent flag evaluation across SDKs. missing for 10: explicit mobile (iOS/Android) SDK evidence, documentation of consistent cross-SDK evaluation behavior, hands-on corroboration across a full stack.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official SDKs across my whole stack — backend, web, and mobile — with consistent flag behavior

citations.quote: It supports 15 official client and server SDKs and over 15 community SDKs.
With over 30 SDKs, we enable fast and secure feature flagging across all major programming languages.
